RIKA_POWER.title: Rika
RIKA_POWER.description:
Yuta's summon. Normally partially manifested at his side, attacking on his behalf.
During Full Manifestation she takes attacks for Yuta; once she falls, she is gone for the rest of combat.
WHICH_ONE_YUTA_POWER.title: Yuta, Which One?
WHICH_ONE_YUTA_POWER.description: During Full Manifestation, at the start of each turn choose 1 of 3 cards from other characters and add it to your hand. It costs 0 this turn.
FULL_MANIFESTATION_POWER.title: Full Manifestation
FULL_MANIFESTATION_POWER.description:
At the start of each turn, gain 2 additional Energy.
Attack damage Yuta would take is dealt to Rika instead.
The amount is the number of turns remaining; at 0 Rika returns to partial manifestation.
